title: Reply composer rejects a valid address that the same ticket's contact already has
date: TAVI 10 Nov 2026 (NDC-Staging, throwaway ticket #2224) · Zoho Desk trial 10 Nov 2026 (read-only, nothing saved)

panels.caption: Reply All on #2224: contact has qa.rt2636@example.com, composer refuses it
Add Contact: same address, no message after leaving the field
Add Contact: a broken address (qa.rt2636@) does get a message

rows.tavi: Accepted: the contact saved with it (201) and shows it under Contact Info

rows.b: Same address in the reply composer
rows.zoho: Accepted (only malformed addresses such as qa.rt2636@ get "Please enter a valid Email")
rows.tavi: "qa.rt2636@example.com is not a valid email address"; the reply cannot go to the ticket's own contact

Any domain ending in .example, .test, .invalid, localhost or example.com/.net/.org (also subdomains). Refused: qa.rt2636@example.com, info@example.org, user@sub.example.com, user@mail.test. Accepted: qa.rt@anyware.software, first.last+tag@gmail.com, a@b.co

notes: Nothing was sent. The Zoho check typed into the Add Contact form only and cancelled without saving.

Cause: a deliberate reserved-domain rule in the shared EmailTagInput component (also used by Send as email, Schedule meeting and the Blueprint designer). Contact validation does not have the rule, so the two disagree.
